areas.name: Godlands
areas.summary: The central high-level band and its trains

claims.text: In the busy Realm, the Godlands has trains: loose crowds of level-20 players moving between gods together, firing in different directions, splitting and regrouping
claims.evidence: Godlands crowd with `gods` and `TURN AROUND` calls: [Nxy2qXlJplg 1:05–1:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nxy2qXlJplg&t=65s). Godlands play: [ONwueEGCAEg 2:14, 4:29, 6:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONwueEGCAEg&t=134s). Owner O15: about 40 players in the busiest Realm
claims.now: Of 16 level-20 bots in the Realm, 1 was hunting a godlands target; the other 15 were exploring or heading toward a remembered band. Almost no Realm bots are near another bot (see [Groups and trains](#area-groups))

claims.text: The busiest Realm holds most of the high-level population; quieter Realms exist
claims.now: Realm size and level-20 share per Realm are unmeasured

claims.text: Gods die often and the crowd moves on to the next one, so god kills set the train's rhythm
claims.now: God kills per hour in the busy Realm are unmeasured

claims.text: Deaths happen here, but a geared level 20 mostly survives a session
claims.evidence: Leveling video Oryx death; deaths to gods in footage
claims.now: 5 level-20 deaths in the first live hour, mostly to gods (02:07–03:14 UTC)

claims.text: Level-20 players with gear go here deliberately, often by teleporting to the train on the minimap
claims.now: Nothing points level-20 bots toward the Godlands, because the map-center target was removed. Teleports are not counted

claims.text: Low-level players appear only briefly, by accident or by following someone, and usually leave or die
claims.evidence: Owner culture notes; unmeasured in footage
claims.now: Low levels die mostly to mid- and high-band monsters (45 of 56 first-hour deaths were levels 1–5); presence here is unmeasured

claims.text: Players stop for god loot bags, then rejoin the crowd
claims.now: Unmeasured

areas.name: Nexus
areas.summary: The hub: arrivals, trade chat and deals

claims.text: Trades actually happen
claims.evidence: Completed exchanges and a 17-Life deal across Vault trips: [Ex_Ix3dlB4U 4:50–6:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ex_Ix3dlB4U&t=290s). No footage gives a rate
claims.now: 0 confirmed bot trades per hour

claims.text: Visibly busy: many players at once, mostly low-star (blue)
claims.evidence: Public Nexus crowds: [G08RmJiBdl8 0:30–0:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G08RmJiBdl8&t=30s), [luV6wQzNZlg 0:10–1:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=luV6wQzNZlg&t=10s). Readable names were 33 blue, 2 red and 5 unknown across sampled scenes; there is no headcount
claims.now: 3–6 of 60 bots in Nexus at any moment

claims.text: Trade chat is a steady background, in varied shapes: priced offers, bare wants, bundles, shorthand, names
claims.evidence: [0z30kcUD1Pc 0:42, 1:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0z30kcUD1Pc&t=42s): `BUYING AMMY 8 DEF @SUPERWIL`, `selling ghostly !`. [Ex_Ix3dlB4U 1:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ex_Ix3dlB4U&t=85s): `SELLING 4 SPD FOR 1 DEF`, `S>Gbow`, `BUYING VBOW`
claims.now: 327 generated ads per hour (about 5 a minute); 410 public chat lines per hour in Nexus. Variety is unmeasured

claims.text: People come and go constantly
claims.evidence: Footage shows turnover but was not timed
claims.now: 274 bot arrivals per hour

claims.text: Commercial gold-site spam exists
claims.now: Bots never do this, and should not

claims.text: The first visit is quieter (tutorial context)
claims.now: n/a: bots don't take the tutorial

claims.text: Most visitors pass through briefly on the way to a portal or the Vault
claims.evidence: Owner reading of C02/C10 and ordinary-play clips; untimed
claims.now: Median Nexus visit 43 s; 39% under 30 s

claims.text: A few traders stand for minutes, repeating a recognisable ad
claims.now: 9% of visits are longer than 5 minutes; per-bot ad repetition is unmeasured

claims.text: Answers to ads are short and about real state (`for bow`, `foor?`, `lemme make room`), with quick rejection of unsuitable offers
claims.now: Unmeasured live, and with 0 trades there are probably few answers

claims.text: Full inventory leads to a Vault trip, then a return to the same spot to finish the deal
claims.now: Vault livelock fixed; 71 bank errands completed in the first live hour (02:07–03:14 UTC); trade-linked Vault trips unmeasured

claims.text: Some people stop to check gear or chat rather than trade
claims.now: Unmeasured

areas.name: Realm travel
areas.summary: Beach to midlands: leveling and exploring

areas.name: Pirate Cave
areas.summary: The first dungeon most players see

claims.text: A large share of Realm players are near others; being alone is a minority state
claims.evidence: Road crowds in [G08RmJiBdl8 2:50–3:20, 6:50–7:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G08RmJiBdl8&t=170s); Godlands crowd in [Nxy2qXlJplg 1:05–1:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nxy2qXlJplg&t=65s). Solo play also exists ([fubGzGmVqpI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fubGzGmVqpI&t=153s)). No proportion is measured
claims.now: 95% of Realm bots have no other bot within 10 tiles; 5% are in pairs; no groups of 3 or more

claims.text: Groups are loose: they change shape and membership, people fire in different directions, and nobody holds a formation slot
claims.now: Too few groups to judge

claims.text: When the front player stops (loot, gear check), others keep going or wait briefly; stragglers catch up
claims.now: Unmeasured

claims.text: Short calls change what people do: `gods`, `TURN AROUND`, `snake`
claims.now: Bot calls are not counted per hour; the earlier owner test of `snake pit` got no response

claims.text: Groups scatter after an event or boss; departure is staggered, with a few lingerers at the loot
claims.now: Unmeasured; belongs partly to the planned Boss fights page

claims.text: Most people join groups by teleporting to someone on the minimap, often but not always; novices may not know how
claims.now: Teleports are not counted separately from transfers

claims.text: Invitations happen, are sometimes declined, and conflict with existing friends
claims.evidence: [fubGzGmVqpI 8:59–9:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fubGzGmVqpI&t=539s) (`but i have my 2 best friends here`)
claims.now: 243 invitations and 160 joins per hour, plus 468 settled without wording, yet bots are almost never near each other

claims.text: Friends survive death: the rebuilt character rejoins
claims.now: Unmeasured; belongs to the planned Death page

claims.text: Help is selective: an HP request gets a Priest heal and `ty`; not every request is answered
claims.evidence: Owner C10; Mad Lab `HP` / `go to the blue pool` ([xyUiQewDLg8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xyUiQewDLg8))
claims.now: Unmeasured
